thread:
Alex K: quick thing — last night some GPU pools showed short bursts of SM% in the low 90s for ~2-3 minutes. saw a couple of jobs with big batch sizes. did anyone else notice or already digging?
Maria C: yep saw alerts from monitor-bot ~02:14 UTC, looked transient. link to the grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/gpu/overview?orgId=1&panelId=7
Sam P: where should I look for the kernel/tracing info? I only see perf counters in the dashboard.
Alex K: for traces use Tempo; there is a GPU trace stream called "gpu-infer-traces". Paste this search in Tempo: `service=gpu-runtime AND trace.kind=inference AND tag.batch_size>1`
Maria C: also check the kv-cache Hitrate panel on the same dashboard (panelId=12). low hitrate + big batches can spike SM% because more cross-GPU traffic.
Jess L: can we get the alert tuned? current memory alert fires at 80% for 90s and it's noisy during autoscale. proposing: memory > 85% for 3m AND sm_percent > 88% for 2m as a compound condition. thoughts? @oncall
monitor-bot: [alert] gpu-pool-prod-3 memory_utilization=82% at 2026-03-16T02:14:12Z (rule: gpu_memory_high)
Sam P: +1 on compound. Also we should exclude bursty load from the nightly batch-run namespace. maybe a label filter: namespace!~"nightly-.*"
Alex K: playful nit: if we raise the threshold we should add a runbook link and a brief rollback step. runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/gpu-memory
Maria C: Draft alert rule (promql) — feel free to tweak:
```
# gpu memory + sm% compound alert
gpu_memory_over_threshold = avg_over_time(nvidia_memory_used_bytes / nvidia_memory_total_bytes[3m]) > 0.85
gpu_sm_over_threshold = avg_over_time(nvidia_sm_utilization[2m]) > 88
gpu_memory_sm_compound = gpu_memory_over_threshold and gpu_sm_over_threshold and on (namespace) namespace !~ "nightly-.*"
```
Alert: GPUHighMemoryAndSM
For panels, add `for: 3m` and annotations for recent deploys.
Jess L: pinging infra-eng for review of the rule and adding runbook link to the alert. @infra-eng
Sam P: small ask — can we add batch_size distribution percentiles to the dashboard? p50/p90/p99 per model. that would help correlate spikes.
Maria C: agree. I can add a new row: batch_size summary + kvcache hitrate + sm% heatmap. will do a PR to dashboard JSON by EOD.
Alex K: thanks. also extra check: if kvcache hrate < 60% and batch p90 > 8 we should expect higher SM%. maybe we add a derived panel to surface that correlation automatically.
monitor-bot: [info] grafana: dashboard update PR opened by Maria C (#423)
Jess L: OK, next steps: 1) infra-eng to review alert tweak, 2) Maria to add batch percentiles and kv hrate panel, 3) Alex to add runbook link and short playbook section for this alert. I'll follow up in #incidents if it re-fires. :thumbsup:
Alex K: thanks — will queue the runbook edits.
Sam P: thanks all. if anyone wants, I can run a quick simulation on staging to validate the new alert rule and dashboard panels.
Maria C: awesome, please do. drop results in this thread.
Jess L: closing loop — marking as ack for now. :white_check_mark:
